sanskrit: ā roha talpaṃ sumanasyamānā- -iha prajāṃ janaya patye asmai | indrāṇīva subudhā budhyamānā jyotirugrā uṣasaḥ prati jāgaraḥ ||
english: Ascend the bridal bed with glad spirit; beget offspring here for this husband. Awakening wisely like Indrāṇī, radiant and mighty, keep watch at dawn.

sanskrit: devā agre ny apadyanta patnīṃ sam aspṛśanta tanvas tanūbhiḥ | sūryeva nāri viśvarūpā mahitvā prajāvatī patye śaṃ bhavāsi ||
english: The gods at the first bestowed the wife upon him; they touched body with body together. Like the sun, O woman, all-formed in thy greatness, bearing offspring, be propitious to thy husband.

sanskrit: ud īrṣvātaḥ pativatnī hy eṣā viśvāvasuṃ namasā gīrbhir īḍe | jāmim iccha pitṛṣadaṃ nyaktāṃ sa te bhāgo januṣā tasya viddhi ||
english: Rise up hence, for she is the wife of a husband; I entreat Viśvāvasu with reverence and songs. Seek a kinswoman who sits with the fathers and dwells in the dark — that is thy share by birth; know him as such.

sanskrit: yā apsarasaḥ sadhamādaṃ madanty antarā havirdhānaṃ sūryaṃ ca | tās te janitram abhi tāḥ parehi namas te gandharva rtunā kṛṇomi ||
english: The Apsarases who revel in common joy between the oblation-cart and the sun — go to them, to thy birthplace; Gandharva, I make obeisance to thee in due season.

sanskrit: namo ghandharvasya manase namo bhāmāya cakṣuṣe ca kṛṇmaḥ | viśvāvaso namo brahmaṇā te kṛṇomy abhi jāyā apsarasaḥ parehi ||
english: We make obeisance to the mind of the Gandharva and to his wrath and to his eye. Viśvāvasu, I make obeisance to thee with prayer; pass beyond to the Apsarases and to the bride.

sanskrit: rāyā vayaṃ sumanasaḥ syāma- -ud ito gandharvam āvīvṛtāma | agan sa devaḥ paramaṃ sadhastham aganma vayaṃ pratiranta āyuḥ ||
english: May we be well-minded with wealth; from here we have turned the Gandharva away. That god has gone to his highest abode; we have gone forward, extending our life-span.

sanskrit: saṃ pitarāv ṛtviye sṛjethāṃ pitā mātā ca retaso bhavāthaḥ | maryo yoṣām adhi rohayaitāṃ prajāṃ kṛṇvāthām iha modamānau ||
english: Let the two parents unite in season; father and mother, be ye the source of seed. Let the young man cause the young woman to mount upon him; may you two make offspring here, rejoicing together.

sanskrit: ā vāṃ prajāṃ janayatu prajāpatir ahorātrābhyāṃ sam anaktv aryamā | adurmaṅgalī patilokam ā viśemaṃ śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
english: May Prajāpati beget offspring for you two; may Aryaman anoint you both with day and night. She who is not ill-omened enters the husband's world; be thou auspicious to us among bipeds and quadrupeds.

sanskrit: tāṃ pūṣañ chivatamām erayasva yasyāṃ bījaṃ manuṣyā vapanti | yā na ūrū uśatī viśrayāti yasyām uśantaḥ praharema śepaḥ ||
english: O Pūṣan, impel for us that most auspicious one into whom men sow their seed, who spreads her thighs for us with desire, into whom, with desire, we would thrust the phallus.

sanskrit: ā rohorum upa dhatsva hastaṃ pari ṣvajasva jāyāṃ sumanasyamānaḥ | prajāṃ kṛṇvāthām iha puṣyataṃ rayiṃ dīrghaṃ vām āyuḥ savitā kṛṇotu ||
english: Ascend her thigh, lay on thy hand, embrace thy wife with glad spirit. May you two beget offspring; may you flourish in wealth here; may Savitā grant long life to you both.

sanskrit: yaṃ no dadur brahmabhāgaṃ vadhūyor vāso vadhvaś ca vastram | yuvaṃ brahmaṇe 'numanyamānau bṛhaspate sākam indraś ca dattam ||
english: The bridal portion of the two brides that they gave us — the garment of the bride — that do you two, Bṛhaspati and Indra, grant together with favor to the brahmin.

sanskrit: devair dattaṃ vanunā sākam etad vādhūyaṃ vadhvo vāso asyāḥ | yo brahmaṇe cikituṣe dadāti sa id rakṣāṃsi talpyāni hanti ||
english: Given by the gods together with beauty is this bridal garment of the bride. He who gives it to a discerning brahmin — he indeed smites the demons of the marriage-bed.

sanskrit: syonād yoner adhi budhyamānau hasāmudau mahasā modamānau | sugū suputrau sugṛhau tarātho jīvā uṣaso vibhātīḥ ||
english: Awakening from the pleasant womb, laughing together, rejoicing in greatness — you two who have good cattle, good sons, a good home, may you cross over and live to see dawning mornings.

sanskrit: navaṃ vasānaḥ surabhiḥ suvāsā udāgāṃ jīva uṣaso vibhātīḥ | āṇḍāt patatrīvāmukṣi viśvasmād enasas pari ||
english: Wearing new garments, fragrant and well-clad, I have come forth alive to the dawning mornings. Like a bird from the egg I have freed myself from every sin.

sanskrit: śumbhanī dyāvāpṛthivī antisumne mahivrate | āpaḥ sapta sravantīs tā no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: O adorning Heaven-and-Earth, in whose realm is happiness, mighty in vow — may the seven flowing waters release us from distress.

sanskrit: sūryāyai devebhyo mitrāya varuṇāya ca | ye bhūtasya pracetasas tebhyo 'ham akaraṃ namaḥ ||
english: To Sūryā, to the gods, to Mitra and to Varuṇa — to those who are the wise overseers of existence — to them I have made obeisance.

sanskrit: ya ṛte cid abhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ | saṃdhātā saṃdhiṃ maghavā purūvasur niṣkartā vihṛtaṃ punaḥ ||
english: He who is shattered even apart from harm, torn before the collar-bones — the bounteous Indra, Purūravas, is the reuniter of joints, the restorer of what is wrenched asunder.

sanskrit: apāsmat tama ucchatu nīlaṃ piśaṅgam uta lohitaṃ yat | nirdahanīṃ pṛṣātakīm asmin tāṃ sthāṇāv adhy ā sṛjāmi ||
english: Let darkness depart away from us — whatever is dark blue, tawny, or red. The scorching, spotted she-demon — I release her onto this post.

sanskrit: yāvatīḥ kṛtyā upavāsane yāvanto rājño varuṇasya pāśāḥ | vyṛddhayo yā asamṛddhayaś ca- -asmin tā sthāṇau prati muñcāmi sarvāḥ ||
english: As many sorceries as cling about us, as many nooses of King Varuṇa — those that harm growth and those that do not bring prosperity — all of them I release onto this post.

sanskrit: ye antā yāvatīḥ sica otavo ye ca tantavaḥ | vāso yat patnībhir utaṃ tan mā syonam upa spṛṣāt ||
english: Whatever borders, whatever selvages there are, the warp-threads and the weft-threads — the garment woven by women: may that touch me pleasantly and bring me ease.

sanskrit: uśatīḥ kanyalā imāḥ pitṛlokāt patiṃ yatīḥ | ava dīkṣām asṛkṣata svāhā ||
english: These willing young girls, going toward a husband from the world of the fathers — they have poured down the consecration. Svāhā!

sanskrit: bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan | varco goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi ||
english: What was released by Bṛhaspati the All-gods upheld; the vigor that has entered into the cows — with that we unite this woman.

sanskrit: bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan | tejo goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi ||
english: What was released by Bṛhaspati the All-gods upheld; the brilliance that has entered into the cows — with that we unite this woman.

sanskrit: bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan | payo goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi ||
english: What was released by Bṛhaspati the All-gods upheld; the milk-nourishment that has entered into the cows — with that we unite this woman.

sanskrit: bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan | yaśo goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi ||
english: What was released by Bṛhaspati the All-gods upheld; the fame that has entered into the cows — with that we unite this woman.

sanskrit: bṛhaspatināvasṛṣṭāṃ viśve devā adhārayan | bhago goṣu praviṣṭaṃ yat tenemāṃ saṃ sṛjāmasi ||
english: What was released by Bṛhaspati the All-gods upheld; the fortune that has entered into the cows — with that we unite this woman.

sanskrit: yad asau duhitā tava vikeśy arudad bahu rodena kṛṇvaty agham | agniṣ ṭvā tasmād enasaḥ savitā ca pra muñcatām ||
english: When that daughter of thine, with disheveled hair, wept aloud, causing much sin with her weeping — may Agni and Savitā release thee from that guilt.

sanskrit: yad amī keśino janā gṛhe te samanartiṣū rodena kṛṇvanto 'gham | (…) ||
english: When those hair-bearing people gathered in thy house, causing sin with their weeping together — [may Agni and Savitā release thee from that guilt].

sanskrit: yaj jāmayo yad yuvatayo gṛhe te samanartiṣū rodena kṛṇvatīr agham | (…) ||
english: When the kinswomen and when the young women in thy house, gathered together, caused sin with their weeping — [may Agni and Savitā release thee from that guilt].

sanskrit: yad imau dampatī ubhau vivāhe agham āratū rodena kṛṇvantāv agham | (…) ||
english: When these two spouses both at the wedding caused sin, causing sin with their weeping — [may Agni and Savitā release thee from that guilt].
